title: Intel reports second-quarter 2026 financial results
excerpt: Intel reported $16.1 billion of second-quarter revenue and guided third-quarter revenue to $15.8-$16.8 billion with GAAP EPS of $0.31 at the midpoint.
summary: The release confirms improved product revenue, DCAI and foundry momentum, but also a $3.2 billion foundry operating loss and substantial execution requirements for 18A, 14A and external customer wins.
